integrity: Standalone proof and direct graph/series verification are included; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete formulas cover labeled rook graphs K_m Cartesian K_n with integers 2<=m<=n; not arbitrary products.
The scalar minimum maximal general-position size m and maximum general-position size m+n-2 were known previously.
Finite arithmetic and graph enumeration corroborate the proof but do not constitute a proof for unrestricted parameters.
Publication priority requires an independent, further literature review; absence from inspected sources is not a uniqueness certificate.
title: Complete general-position enumerators and gapped maximal spectra of rook graphs
